title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E01 — Pluto's Stranger Things
Evidence of alien technology around a distant star; speculation about Pluto's surface; Apollo astronauts are at a loss of words to describe an object they encountered while they approached the moon.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E04 — The Earth Next Door
Astronomers notice a planet in Earth's vicinity capable of supporting life; top secret military program exposed; the moon contains the components to start life.

title: How the Universe Works
description:

Our solar system is home to hundreds of strange, tiny worlds called dwarf planets, and new discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E04 — Death of the Milky Way
Experts utilize the latest science and discoveries to investigate the cause of the Milky Way galaxy's gradual death.

title: How the Universe Works
description:

Our solar system hides a dark and violent past and new discoveries reveal that Earth and the planets were formed from the destruction of alien worlds that came before us.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E03 — Sutro Tower
Trask and his crew scale Sutro Tower to inspect crucial cable junctions and must avoid deadly radiation at nearly 1,000 feet in the air; in Oregon, loose boulders need to be removed along a cliffside road that needs to be reopened.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E04 — Space Needle
Trask and his team take on the iconic Space Needle in Seattle to fix an aging window-washing basket; in San Antonio, they look to get a stadium ready for game day.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E02 — Frying Pan Tower
Trask takes on a decommissioned lighthouse 32 miles off the coast of North Carolina, and the crew must work suspended above shark-infested waters; an aging stadium with corroding catwalks needs maintenance for hockey season.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E05 — Foresthill Bridge
Trask and his crew look for any critical issues on Foresthill Bridge in California, a vital escape route during wildfires; in Garden City, Kan., the team needs to inspect massive grain elevators where one spark could ignite a devastating explosion.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E01 — Pegasus and Dragon
Trask and his crew take on one of the world's largest bronze statues, Pegasus and Dragon, and they need to figure out how to get on this colossus of a structure; one of the world's largest roller coasters is due for an inspection.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E06 — New Bullards Dam
Trask and his crew take on New Bullards Dam, and they need to place critical target sensors for monitoring seismic activity; in Colorado, a bird detection system needs to be installed at a wind turbine facility.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E01 — Mayhem in Minneapolis
A deadly design flaw results in a horrifying rush hour bridge collapse that tragically leaves 13 dead in Minneapolis; using the latest science, experts investigate to reveal what went so catastrophically wrong on one of Minnesota's busiest crossings.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E02 — Sinkhole at the Museum
Experts look at engineering blunders that have either caused catastrophes or are disasters waiting to happen; they use cutting-edge technology to examine what went wrong and to figure out if they can be fixed.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E03 — Train of Terror
A devastating rail disaster outside a small North Dakota town results in cargo erupting in massive explosions; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover an engineering flaw poised for catastrophic failure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E05 — Calamity Comes to Canada
Tragedy strikes a bustling Canadian shopping mall when a parking garage suddenly collapses resulting in a fatal disaster; expert engineers use the latest technology to investigate and uncover a deadly design flaw that could have been prevented.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:

A theory of Earth's abiogenesis may have started in the clouds of Venus; a look into the claim of Earth having two moons; a NASA scientist helps the FBI solve the 1996 Olympic bombing.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E02 — Twin Suns: The Alien Mysteries
Star systems with binary stars, once relegated to science-fiction, may actually exist and serve as ideal places for alien life to thrive.

title: How the Universe Works

Scientists use technology to stop an asteroid apocalypse; mankind comes closer to keeping Earth safe from killer space rocks.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E07 — The Doom of El Dorado
The remnants of a settlement in Nevada are interspersed with disintegrating machinery; experts uncover an abandoned mine where dreams of discovering a fortune were met with chaos and murder.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E02 — American Ghost Park
Deep in the wilderness of the American South, a long-abandoned amusement park is home to secrets of a forgotten, imaginary world; experts reveal why this bizarre place was built and what caused its downfall.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E11 — Ghosts of the Cursed Castle
The ruins of a historic Scottish castle is now a bewitching wilderness of hidden dangers with deadly booby traps obscured afoot; experts and historians reveal a bygone Second World War military hospital with bizarre ties to an infamous Nazi occupant.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E01 — Into the Murder Labyrinth
An underground labyrinth once used by a secret police force could warp the mind and turn friend into foe; experts turn up new evidence pointing to madness, murder and mayhem, revealing what happened in these cursed tunnels and why it was abandoned.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E05 — Factory of Death
A deserted facility in the remote countryside features mysterious graffiti that may be highly advanced mathematical equations pointing to a dark secret; experts investigate this classified military wasteland with a deadly past.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E10 — Mystery of the Alien Base
Abandoned hangers and bunkers populate a bizarre facility in the middle of nowhere, but among them are other structures whose purpose are oddly obscured; experts investigate a highly-classified military cover-up with extraterrestrial objectives.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E05 — Skyscraper Collapses
Pinpoint the mistakes that cause major structural failures; explore the preventable explosion inside London's Ronan Point; the code violations that collapsed Lalita Park; the short circuit that set off a deadly fire in Tehran's Plasco Building.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E02 — Bridge Collapses
Bridge collapses have etched hard lessons into the history of engineering; Tacoma, Minneapolis, Genoa, symbols of innovation that have become stark reminders of what happens when flaws go unchecked.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E06 — Nuclear Plant Disasters
Hunt for the root cause of atomic accidents; examine the Windscale fire, which led to safer reactor designs; learn why swift crisis management helped in the Three Mile Island incident; see why improper waste disposal fuelled the Kyshtym disaster.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:

When a swarm of craft floods New Jersey's skies, panic erupts online; Andrew digs into every conspiracy theory, interviewing eyewitnesses and testing cutting-edge drone tech, until he uncovers the truth behind the incident.

Uranus and Neptune are mysterious, icy worlds at the edge of the solar system; new discoveries reveal that these strange planets may have helped start life on Earth.

Mercury is a deadly world, facing attacks from the Sun, comets, and other planets; even though it's the smallest planet in the solar system, Mercury has a dangerous secret that may one day threaten life on Earth.

Investigating the contentious theory that Jesus was married with children and his bloodline lives on today.

Western myths; airbags.

S02 E06 — Titanic Phenomenon
Jeremy Wade investigates the infamous shipwreck of the Titanic; locals are baffled when a bag containing 54 severed human hands is found on the banks of a Siberian river.

Jeremy Wade examines new evidence that could finally reveal what happened to aviator Amelia Earhart; Jeremy investigates a strange anchor found in the Mediterranean Sea.

Jeremy Wade follows investigators as they dive the wreck of the ferry MS Estonia; the case of America's notorious skyjacker D. B. Cooper takes an intriguing underwater twist.

Jeremy Wade explores an accident involving a Russian nuclear submarine on a top-secret mission, and shocking details emerge surrounding the vessel's design; scientists investigate ancient human remains emerging from a lake in Finland.

title: Mysteries of the Deep

Exploring the puzzling disappearance of an Indonesian submarine; the latest research into an underwater phenomenon may help piece together how it vanished.

S01 E03 — Secrets of Skull Grave
Archaeologists excavating a historic Chilean site make a chilling discovery and find decapitated human skulls separate from a nearby burial site; experts use advanced cranial forensics to reveal what happened to these ancient, butchered victims.

title: Ancient Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E06 — Gladiator Graveyard
A mass grave of mutilated skeletons is unearthed at the frontier of the Roman Empire, experts use advanced digital analysis to reveal the mystery behind these grisly remains.

S01 E09 — Legend of the Cursed Temple
A temple to the Roman god of the underworld is the site of ritual sacrifice and a gate to the underworld, but it was buried because it was believed to be cursed; experts use cutting-edge forensics to reveal what actually happened here.

title: Ancient Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E04 — War of the Ancients
An archaeological excavation uncovers ancient human carnage; experts use 3D modeling to reveal what may be the first major war in human history.

title: Ancient Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E07 — Grave of the Red Skulls
When experts discover a 500-year-old grave, they find mysterious red skulls, pointing to a shocking mass sacrifice; experts use the latest technology and state-of-the-art forensics to investigate what happened at this horrific site.
